name: Shakir Ali
full_role: Venue Writer and Matchday Planning Editor
description: Shakir Ali writes CPL venue guides, host-territory context and practical matchday planning information.
bio: Shakir Ali covers the grounds and host territories on the CPL calendar. His venue work combines cricket history with practical details such as location, schedule windows and matchday planning.
He keeps travel advice tied to confirmed tournament information and directs readers to authorized ticket channels rather than unverified sellers.
coverage_focus: Ground guides, host territories and matchday context
method: Checks venue identity, location and fixture windows before publication.
Separates permanent ground facts from event-specific arrangements.
Avoids promising transport, entry or ticket details that organizers have not confirmed.
